title: Add canonical relationships, aliases, topic indexes, and non-exact lookup
description:
Make the corpus discoverable by the primary DM and by deterministic tools without
requiring exact kind + normalized title.

Root cause: lookup is exact-key based, duplicate display names are unqualified,
and options have no globally resolvable identity, so a tool that knows the
concept but not the key cannot find the canonical rule.

Required membership — all of:
- qualified names for duplicate feature names;
- canonical owner links for duplicate rule concepts;
- an option index, or globally resolvable option identities;
- aliases, tags, topics, family/group indexes, and relationship-aware lookup;
- discoverability for concepts whose source title differs from common query
  language.

Closes findings: F-14, F-22, CAP-011, Fable F8, and the discoverable dimension of
SOL-001.
acceptance_criteria:
- The primary DM and deterministic tools can find canonical records without knowing the exact kind and normalized title.
- Every duplicate display name resolves to a qualified, unambiguous identity.
- Every option (fighting style, invocation, metamagic, pact boon, Hunter option, variant) has a globally resolvable identifier usable as a lookup key.
- Relationship-aware lookup returns the canonical owner for duplicated rule concepts.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
